member.name: T:HelloModule.BlockBehaviorGreeter
member.summary: Sends the player a greeting on interact - the whole point of the module. Any mod's block picks this up with .Behavior<BlockBehaviorGreeter>(), which resolves to hellomodule.BlockBehaviorGreeter through this assembly's own [assembly: ExDomain] rather than the calling block's - the cross-assembly key path this sample exists to prove. Handling stays , so the block's own click handler still runs.
